purpose: Extract the complete eta=0 first-order AeST/metric state on the same accepted CLASS perturbation source grid used by the validated chi trace, establish the exact Newtonian-gauge to longitudinal 3+1 dictionary needed for H3, and determine if the remaining standard-matter sector is exactly representable by the already certified pressureless GE07 closure.

accepted_grid.location: perturbations_sources() after perturbations_einstein() on scalar source samples

exact_dictionary.metric: ds^2=-(1+2 psi)dt^2+a^2(1-2 phi)dx^2, so deltaN=psi, deltaL/a=deltaR/a=-phi, delta b=0
exact_dictionary.rapidity: at linear order A_x=a r=partial_x alpha, so the longitudinal rapidity Fourier-gradient amplitude is r_L=(k/a) alpha up to the fixed Fourier derivative phase

matter_completeness.dark_subtraction: subtract the AeST effective-dark delta-rho, momentum and pressure contributions from CLASS total stress-energy; AeST contributes no direct scalar anisotropic shear in the frozen v0.19 bridge
matter_completeness.readiness_rule: H3 pressureless CLASS-reference readiness requires both ||delta_p_std||/||delta_rho_std|| and ||shear_std||/||delta_rho_std|| <=1e-12 on the frozen audit window. Failure does not fail the state bridge; it classifies the full cosmological H3 matter closure as incomplete.

claim_boundary: GE08 only certifies first-order state extraction/dictionary and exact pressureless-matter completeness on the frozen late-time CLASS reference. It does not solve Z20 or Z21, introduce finite eta, or make nonlinear-collapse/observational claims.
anti_tuning: Do not change the trace location, field list, state dictionary, k/redshift window, bridge thresholds, pressureless-readiness threshold or terminal rules after inspecting GE08 output.
